today was the first day i used it on avicus. i don't know if the previous owner played on this server, but today was the first day i used it on avicus with my little cousin. he was playing with my younger brother and was trolling/griefing their teammates. as long as they had fun i did not mind, but then it got a temp ban as they did not listen to the warning myworld6 gave them. they did apologies to me, and i apologies on behalf of them.

I did not hack or did anything wrong on that account.
nor do i know if this is actin, but just to clarify i am not trying to break the rules or make any attempts.
